thesis: This episode argues that Merck (MRK) is a high-margin cancer business with a dominant revenue driver in Ketruda, which faces patent cliffs but has diversified through aggressive acquisitions and new antibody drug conjugates. The thesis is mixed: while Merck has a strong core competency in clinical execution and can command premium pricing, investors must be clear-eyed about the challenges of replacing a large drug and the historical difficulty of patent cliffs in pharma.
